name: @hi-man/himan-tracker
description: Local-first observability and analytics for AI coding agents.

scripts.release: pnpm run verify && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:dry: pnpm run verify && npm publish --access public --dry-run
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm run changelog:release
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm run changelog:release
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm run changelog:release
